title: Web search: the person's search key for models without their own web search
$comment: The key lives in ~/.config/web-search/key.json, which the person's own daemon writes and the core runtime's search extension reads. Errors are the common envelope with fixed codes: search_key_rejected (409, the search service refused the key in the trial search), search_limit_reached (429, the service's or the daemon's limit), search_unavailable (503, the service did not answer). A key update is saved only after its trial search has passed. Nothing the service said crosses.

key_state.$comment: refused_at is when the search extension last recorded the service refusing exactly this key (matched by its SHA-256 and service), null otherwise. native_providers are the Pi providers the installed search extension serves with their own web search, from its native-search.json; null when the daemon could not read the list. The browser compares them with the person's providers; neither side keeps a table of its own.

key_update.$comment: Only Brave is offered until Staan's coverage has been checked: a Staan key has no trial search yet. A key for one service replaces a key for the other, since search uses one service at a time.
